source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Names slave, yoke and master directly and retains reputation as the rationale.
key_decisions.before: All who are under the yoke as slaves should regard their own masters as worthy of full honor, so that God’s name and the teaching are not slandered.
key_decisions.after: All who are slaves under a yoke must regard their own masters as worthy of full honor, so that God's name and the teaching may not be slandered.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let all who are under the yoke as slaves regard their own masters as worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be slandered.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the coercive hierarchy and the text's intensified service command without calling it harmless.
key_decisions.before: Those who have believing masters must not disrespect them because they are brothers and sisters; rather, they should serve them all the more because those who receive the benefit are believers and beloved. Teach and urge these things.
key_decisions.after: Those who have believing masters must not disrespect them because they are brothers; instead, they must serve as slaves all the more, because those who benefit are believers and beloved. Teach and urge these things.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Those who have believing masters must not be disrespectful because they are brothers, but rather serve them all the more, since those who benefit from their good service are believers and beloved.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps desire for wealth as subject and the drowning image.
key_decisions.before: Those who want to be rich fall into testing and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
key_decisions.after: But those who want to be rich fall into temptation, a trap and many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But those who want to be rich fall into temptation and a snare and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves root, wandering and self-impalement images without calling money itself the root.
key_decisions.before: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.
key_decisions.after: For love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils, and by reaching for it some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both witnesses, universal life-giving and historical name.
key_decisions.before: I charge you before God, who gives life to all things, and Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,
key_decisions.after: I command you before God, who gives life to all things, and Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps timing and three rule titles.
key_decisions.before: which the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords, will reveal at the proper time,
key_decisions.after: which he will reveal at the proper time—the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: which he will display at the proper time—he who is the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains transcendence, human limitation and doxology.
key_decisions.before: the only one who has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no human being has seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal power. Amen.
key_decisions.after: who alone has immortality and dwells in unapproachable light, whom no human has seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal power. Amen.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal dominion. Amen.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps temporal wealth, its instability and divine generosity.
key_decisions.before: Command those who are rich in this present age not to be arrogant or set their hope on uncertain wealth, but on God, who richly provides us everything for enjoyment.
key_decisions.after: Command those who are rich in this present age not to be arrogant or set their hope on uncertain wealth, but on God, who richly provides us with everything for enjoyment.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Command those who are rich in the present age not to be arrogant, nor to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who richly provides us with everything for enjoyment.
